chunks: On the day the earth and mountains will rock violently, and the mountains turn to a heap of poured-out sand.
ai.seo_question: What happens to the mountains on the Day of Resurrection according to Surah Al-Muddaththir?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse from Surah Al-Muddaththir (74:20) is often cited to illustrate the absolute power of Allah in dismantling the perceived permanence of creation, serving as a warning to those who deny the Resurrection. The transformation of mountains into 'powdered dust' (kathiban mahila) signifies not just physical destruction but the removal of all sources of stability and authority, preparing the stage for divine judgment.
